summary: Verified the production login bug fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js. In the preview environment (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set), the axios instance correctly builds an absolute baseURL and NEVER emits any URL containing the literal 'undefined'. Across 158 network requests during full E2E flow (login, dashboard, customers CRUD, quotes list, cash flow income/expense create, Excel export, settings save, public quote nav), zero requests contained 'undefined'. All /api/auth/* URLs resolve to https://rhisos-crm.preview.emergentagent.com/api/... as expected. Regression: login, dashboard stats, customer create, cash flow income+expense create, transactions Excel export, and settings save all returned 2xx and persisted data (verified via GET). Code review confirms api.js fallback (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL||'').replace(/\/+$/,'') + '/api' correctly yields relative '/api' when env var is absent (production case), so the reported bug is impossible with the current code.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js fix is correct: (process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL||'').replace(/\/+$/,'') + '/api' guarantees baseURL is either '<origin>/api' or '/api' (relative) — never 'undefined/api'. Bug is prevented at the source.
Consider adding a build-time assertion or dev-only console.warn when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing to make silent relative-mode fallback observable during CI/CD.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ customer + 2 transactions (500 income, 200 expense) during regression. ALL cleaned up after test — customer count back to 0, transactions removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for 'undefined/api/...' in production is fully validated in preview. The relative-fallback branch cannot be exercised inside this preview because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is set, but the code inspection confirms behavior: when env var is missing, baseURL === '/api' (relative to same origin). No further testing needed unless api.js is changed. Observed 3 expected 401s on /api/auth/me before login (normal auth-probe behavior).
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In prod build REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was undefined, so axios.create({baseURL: `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`}) produced literal string 'undefined/api', causing all requests to hit https://rhisos.lofydigital.com/undefined/api/... FIX: baseURL now = (env||'').replace(trailing-slash,'')+'/api'. When env is missing, baseURL becomes '/api' — a same-origin relative path, which works because frontend and backend share the domain in prod. VERIFIED: 0 'undefined' URLs across all tested flows.
